name: Wetrok
legalEntityNote: Wetrok AG is the Swiss company named in the official imprint. Diethelm Keller Group identifies Wetrok as its industrial operating unit; regional Wetrok entities, authorized dealers, importers, contracting sellers and service providers can carry separate responsibilities.

ownership.summary: Diethelm Keller Group's official industrial-unit page says Wetrok has been part of the group since 1955. The group describes itself as family-owned and identifies Wetrok as its Swiss B2B professional-cleaning operation. Wetrok AG remains the named Swiss operating company; the reviewed sources do not disclose an intermediate legal holding chain above Wetrok AG.

leadership.name: Benjamin Merz
leadership.context: Diethelm Keller Group's official industrial-unit page identifies Benjamin Merz as Wetrok's Managing Director.

productPortfolio.name: Professional cleaning machines
productPortfolio.positioning: Scrubber-driers, sweepers, single-disc machines, wet and dry vacuums and cleaning robots cover mechanized professional floorcare.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match working width, tank, battery, floor, filtration, safety and realistic productivity to the site and exact model.

productPortfolio.name: Cleaning and disinfection chemicals
productPortfolio.positioning: Cleaning, care, protection and disinfection products support Wetrok's integrated systems approach.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify formulation, intended surface, dilution, safety data, ecolabel scope, local registration and machine compatibility.

productPortfolio.name: Tools, carts and consumables
productPortfolio.positioning: Manual tools, transport systems, hygiene supplies and consumables extend the portfolio beyond machines.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm replacement availability, compatibility, material durability and local replenishment terms.

productPortfolio.name: Methods, training and digital systems
productPortfolio.positioning: Cleaning concepts, application training and digital support connect products to standardized professional workflows.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Define training language, reporting access, implementation responsibilities and measurable process outcomes.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Diethelm Keller Group states that Wetrok's research, development and production are based in Switzerland.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Group statement about Wetrok's operating model; it does not prove Swiss origin for every finished SKU or component
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Request the exact product's manufacturer, production site, serial plate, country of origin and applicable declaration.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Wetrok says its own engineering department, chemistry laboratory and internal teams develop and test machines and cleaning agents in company laboratories and production facilities.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company-level engineering, laboratory and production capabilities
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Ask which design, formulation, assembly and testing steps apply to the quoted product and which components are externally sourced.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Wetrok's product catalogue separates machines, chemicals, tools and consumables into different product systems.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Portfolio taxonomy, not evidence of one common manufacturing route
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not generalize the origin or supplier chain of one category to another; verify each contracted line.

marketsChannels.evidence: Wetrok says subsidiaries serve customers in Germany, Poland, Sweden and Austria, while authorized dealers cover about 40 additional countries.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the authorized local entity, dealer territory, importer, contracting seller and warranty provider.

marketsChannels.evidence: Wetrok's Swiss sales and service terms identify Wetrok AG as the contracting party for named professional-customer transactions and service agreements.
marketsChannels.scope: Switzerland and the stated terms; not a global contracting rule
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Obtain the destination market's current sales, warranty and service terms from the named legal entity.

marketsChannels.evidence: Wetrok combines product sales with advice, training, machine service and spare-parts routes.
marketsChannels.scope: Published support framework; local delivery capability can vary
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Record technician coverage, parts stock, response time, training scope and escalation contacts in the contract.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Wetrok competes through a long-established Swiss professional-cleaning system that combines machines, chemistry, methods and training. Buyers should test whether that integrated proposition is backed by exact-model evidence and locally enforceable service capacity.

developments.title: Wetrok joins Diethelm Keller Group
